- Re-harvested both documents in full from Internet Archive captures of the **identical deposits** (83-page Ch.-11 edition, 704,812 B; 6-page note, 187,464 B), added as separate fetch-verified source entries.
- Converted the four HAL entries to compliant drop records (attempts, searches, per-item alternative arguments with deps), and re-pointed item references to the verified captures.
